messages:
Emma: Planning a US‑East maintenance window Friday 01:30-03:00 UTC. We'll do rolling control-plane drains + soft reboots across 4 cohorts (approx 24 hosts). Purpose: NIC microcode + kernel livepatch. Expect hosted capacity ~10% down during peak. Dedicated: cordon-only unless health fails. Please ack and surface blockers.

Raj: Ack. Which racks are in scope? Any customer-specific no-evict tags?

Emma: Scope = use1-rack-11..14 (labels: pool-hosted-chat, pool-hosted-text, pool-embeddings). We've applied `redwood/evict=manual` to two enterprise-dedicated racks.

Oncall-sre: Note: last time we saw transient BGP withdraws when NIC restarted. Network team to run `bgp-grace 90` and hold timers. Also planning a small control-plane throttle.

Lina: I'll coordinate network steps. Plan: drain control-plane peer sessions, run `./tools/bgptest --hold 90` then trigger reboots. infra-bot preflight will confirm.

Ben: Cost heads-up: routing a portion of traffic to us-west for fallback will increase egress and token spend. cost-bot, can you project delta?

cost-bot: Estimated delta: +4-8% token spend for the window under current traffic. If KV cache miss > 15% we could hit +12%. Alerting configured at +9%.

Emma: If we exceed +9% we will enable embedding write throttles and pause noninteractive eval jobs. Finance notified.

Oncall-sre: Rollback criteria proposed: p95 > 700ms sustained 5m OR request error-rate >1% for 3m OR any host showing repeated NIC flaps. Rollback steps = stop reboots, revert routing to baseline, uncordon stable hosts, escalate. Agree?

Raj: Agree. Also add queue depth > 2000 as a signal.

Lina: Preflight started: `infra-bot run preflight --cohort use1-rack-11-14`

infra-bot: Preflight results: disks OK, NIC firmware version mismatch detected on 2 hosts (staged), kv-cache baseline hit 80%, bgp-grace applied. Canary will hit 01:10 UTC.

Emma: Thanks. Please pause heavy batch jobs 45m prior. We'll post live updates here during the window. Final reminder 1h before.

Ben: Posting maintenance on status page and paging the oncall.

Oncall-sre: Acknowledged.
